1. Checking the official website or documentation of the initiative
2. Contacting the organization or group behind the initiative directly
3. Looking at official government or regulatory websites for the relevant jurisdiction
4. Checking recent news articles or announcements about the initiative

If you can provide more context about which specific initiative you're referring to, I might be able to help you find where to look for that information.
